verdict.rationale: An agent-consumable docs index exists at docs.deepinfra.com/llms.txt, and it links a machine-readable OpenAPI 3.1 spec; markdown doc pages such as docs.deepinfra.com/models.md are also served. However, the canonical deepinfra.com/llms.txt and deepinfra.com/docs.md both returned 404 to probes (llms.txt sits behind a bot challenge), so an agent pointed at the main domain fails. missing for 10: llms.txt reachable at the main domain without a bot challenge, first-party documentation describing the llms.txt or agent-oriented docs offering, independent hands-on corroboration of an agent consuming the docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: The docs index cites it: docs.deepinfra.com/llms.txt ends with "## OpenAPI Specs" listing the same document.
deepinfra.com/llms.txt sits behind a bot challenge; docs.deepinfra.com is the reachable index.
